transcript.text: Good morning, Coastline Tours, Emma speaking. How can I help you?
transcript.speaker: EMMA

transcript.text: Hello. I'd like to book a day trip for my family, please. I saw your advertisement in the newspaper.
transcript.speaker: TOM

transcript.text: Thanks. Is this the right number for the Lake Harbour trip? A friend of mine went last year and said it was excellent.
transcript.speaker: TOM

transcript.text: Yes, you've come to the right place. It's one of our most popular tours, so I'm glad you called early.
transcript.speaker: EMMA

transcript.text: Of course. Can I take your name first?
transcript.speaker: EMMA

transcript.text: Yes, it's Tom Baxter. That's B-A-X-T-E-R.
transcript.speaker: TOM

transcript.text: Thank you, Mr Baxter. And which trip are you interested in? We have three at the moment.
transcript.speaker: EMMA

transcript.text: The one to Lake Harbour. My children love boats, and I read that you can take a short cruise there.
transcript.speaker: TOM

transcript.text: It's a lovely trip. The boat goes around the whole lake, and the guide tells stories about the history of the area.
transcript.speaker: EMMA

transcript.text: My children will love that. How long is the boat part?
transcript.speaker: TOM

transcript.text: About an hour, and then you have free time to explore the town.
transcript.speaker: EMMA

transcript.text: That's right. We run it every Saturday and Sunday. Which day would you like?
transcript.speaker: EMMA

transcript.text: Saturday, please. The fourteenth of June.
transcript.speaker: TOM

transcript.text: Let me check. Yes, there are seats. How many people will be travelling?
transcript.speaker: EMMA

transcript.text: Five. Two adults and three children. Oh, wait, my sister might come too, so make it six.
transcript.speaker: TOM

transcript.text: Six people, no problem. We have two pick-up points. One is at the central station and the other is at the Market Square.
transcript.speaker: EMMA

transcript.text: The Market Square is closer for us.
transcript.speaker: TOM

transcript.text: That's a good choice, because it's also near the free car park, if anyone decides to drive.
transcript.speaker: EMMA

transcript.text: Good to know, thank you.
transcript.speaker: TOM

transcript.text: Good. Can I have a contact number, in case there's a change?
transcript.speaker: EMMA

transcript.text: Yes, it's five five five, two oh nine one.
transcript.speaker: TOM

transcript.text: Thank you. I'll also send a text message the day before to remind you.
transcript.speaker: EMMA

transcript.text: That's very helpful, I tend to forget things.
transcript.speaker: TOM

transcript.text: Thank you. Now, the details. The bus leaves at eight forty-five, but please arrive ten minutes early so that we can check your tickets.
transcript.speaker: EMMA

transcript.text: Right. And how much is it altogether?
transcript.speaker: TOM

transcript.text: It's twenty-five pounds for adults and fifteen pounds for children. Children under five travel free, so that might save you something.
transcript.speaker: EMMA

transcript.text: My youngest is four, so that's good news. Is lunch included?
transcript.speaker: TOM

transcript.text: No, but there is a café at the harbour, and you can also bring a picnic. I'd recommend bringing a sun hat and some sun cream, because there's little shade on the boat.
transcript.speaker: EMMA

transcript.text: A sun hat is a good idea. The last time we went to the coast, the children got sunburnt.
transcript.speaker: TOM

transcript.text: It happens very easily near water, so it's worth being careful.
transcript.speaker: EMMA

transcript.text: Thanks for the advice. Can I pay now?
transcript.speaker: TOM

transcript.text: You can pay by card over the phone, or you can pay in cash when you board. If you pay now, you get a discount of five percent.
transcript.speaker: EMMA

transcript.text: In that case I'll pay by card now.
transcript.speaker: TOM

transcript.text: Perfect. Let me take the details.
transcript.speaker: EMMA

transcript.text: Wonderful. Thanks for all your help, Emma. Goodbye.
transcript.speaker: TOM

transcript.text: Goodbye, Mr Baxter, and enjoy the trip.
transcript.speaker: EMMA
